review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on role with real ownership. Once You're Here, You Will Administer and maintain our core network infrastructure, including Palo Alto firewalls, Engenius switches, MikroTik routers, and wireless access points across Head Office and field offices Manage our on-premise servers and virtual machines, ensuring availability, performance, and reliable backups at all times Oversee our cloud platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, AWS, or equivalent, covering user access management, configuration, and cost monitoring Own IT security practices end-to-end: firewall policies, VPN, endpoint controls, patch management, and incident response Manage the full IT asset lifecycle, from procurement and inventory tracking through to maintenance and retirement Manage relationships with hardware, software, and connectivity vendors, ensuring service quality, reliable delivery and cost
